unit: Unit 12: Everyday Life with Your Computer
title: Now do it all on your own computer
drDigitalIntro:
One errand, from looking something up to having it saved where you can find it again.
• You will look up something genuinely local — bus times, opening hours, a phone number — and copy the address of the page you found it on.
• Then you will save that page as a PDF instead of printing it onto paper, and hand the PDF back to this page.
• Save as PDF lives inside the Print window on every computer. Most people never notice it is there, and it turns any page into a document you keep.
• The PDF has to be one you made in the last half hour, so this only passes if you really do it now.

playgroundTask.goal: You ran a real errand from start to finish

steps.say: Look up something local and real — bus times, opening hours, a phone number.
steps.detail: Something you would genuinely want to know today. The errand is the point; the practice is the by-product.

steps.say: Copy the web address of the page you found it on and paste it here.
steps.detail: Click once on the address bar to select the whole address, copy it with Ctrl+C or Command+C, then paste it into the box below. That is also how you send a page to somebody else.

steps.say: Print that page to a PDF instead of paper.
steps.detail: Press Ctrl+P, or Command+P on a Mac. In the window that opens, change the printer to Save as PDF — on Windows it is called Microsoft Print to PDF. Then choose where to save it.

steps.say: Pick the PDF you just saved.
steps.detail: It went wherever you told it to — usually Documents or Downloads. The page checks that it really is a PDF and that you made it just now.

steps.say: Put one real thing in your calendar with a reminder.
steps.detail: An appointment, a bin day, someone's birthday. A reminder you will actually receive beats a note you have to remember to read.

drDigitalSuccess: You looked something up, kept the address, turned a web page into a document and saved it where you can find it. That is a whole errand done on a computer.
drDigitalHint: For the PDF step: it is inside the Print window, not the Save menu. Change the destination from your printer to Save as PDF.
